title: Libby Newell Memorial Grant Program for Volunteer Museums (Australia)
desc: Deadline: 18-Sep-2026 The Libby Newell Memorial Grant Program provides a $5,000 grant to support exhibition development at one volunteer-run museum in New South Wales (NSW), Australia. Administered by Museums & Galleries of NSW, the program aims to strengthen volunteer museums, improve exhibition quality, and create better experiences for visitors and local communities.
